verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same flaws. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to the size of the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the action is buried. 'Sessions' is jammed near the bottom edge, and the italic subhead is squeezed between the headline and the date. The 'Reserve a spot' line and the legal text are tiny, and the placeholder image box and the small product can float in the right corner. B is slightly worse because its SOLSTICE wordmark is damaged: it reads as 'SOLST CE', with a glyph missing or covered, which breaks the brand.
